as_written_in_papers.quote: GFAP gene analysis identified a homozygous c.740 C>T pSer247Phe missense variant.

cases.statement: One carrier: Case 3, a woman in her early 70s, reported as homozygous, with syncope as the first symptom and later ataxia, spasticity and dysautonomia.

people.label: Case 3
people.key_phenotypes: episodic orthostatic syncope as first symptom; progressive gait and speech disturbance; broken saccades, dysarthria, limb ataxia and lower-limb spasticity with extensor plantars; orthostatic hypotension and bladder dysfunction; atrophy and signal change of medulla and upper cervical cord with cerebellar atrophy

quotes.quote: A woman in her early 70s was referred with episodic syncope and progressive gait disturbance.

Neurological examination showed broken saccadic eye movements, dysarthria and limb ataxia as well as spasticity of the lower extremities with positive extensor plantar responses, orthostatic hypotension and bladder dysfunction.

MR scan of the brain 3 years after symptom onset showed atrophy and T2/fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) signal abnormality of the medulla oblongata and upper cervical cord, as well as atrophy of the cerebellum and middle cerebellar peduncle (figure 5).
GFAP gene analysis identified a homozygous c.740 C>T pSer247Phe missense variant.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Adult-onset pattern with brainstem/cervical cord involvement; no family history of neurological conditions. Whether other genes or causes were excluded is not reported (the paper describes 'GFAP gene analysis' only).

quotes.quote: She had no family history of any neurological conditions.
Adults with AxD may present with autonomic dysfunction, such as repeated fainting, as the initial symptom.

segregation.statement: No relatives tested; no family history of neurological conditions.

quotes.quote: She had no family history of any neurological conditions.

in_trans.statement: not applicable (autosomal dominant disease); the paper states a homozygous genotype without parental testing or consanguinity information

quotes.quote: GFAP gene analysis identified a homozygous c.740 C>T pSer247Phe missense variant.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense, p.(Ser247Phe). The paper's general mechanism statement: excess production and accumulation of GFAP in astrocytes.

quotes.quote: Its pathophysiology is characterised by excess production and accumulation of GFAP in astrocytes

concerns: Zygosity: the paper states 'homozygous' for a disease the papers describe as autosomal dominant; the paper gives no comment, no parental testing and no consanguinity information. The panel may want to check whether this is a reporting error.

The variant sentence cites reference 20, which is the Waisman Center GFAP variant list (an online variant listing, not a case report); no primary report of this person is cited. The paper is a clinical review with illustrative cases, and the case may have been reported elsewhere.
Protein written 'pSer247Phe' (no dot); this is a formatting difference only and matches the predicted p.(Ser247Phe).
notes_for_panel: Single illustrative case in a review article; zygosity as stated is unusual for this disease and is unexplained in the paper.
